S.FORM: Kulēi Wrisris m-mat / m̄rag kulēi Wrisris m-mat gēn nen̄, tuar tdun so lēs ni.
S.TRANSL: After the death of Wrisris, right after his death, someone else took his place.

S.FORM: Tuar tdun m-lēs ni sa, na ssan Wedām.
S.TRANSL: That other person who replaced him was called Wendaam.

S.FORM: Nēk va-mrōs vanvan kēl mlē a Mke-Grāt, dek gēn nēk va-mrōs tek nēr o ratle tmat, nēk to tek late sur Wrisris m-mat nok.
S.TRANSL: If you want to walk back in the volcano again to visit the world of Ghosts, it is now impossible, because Wrisris is dead now.

S.FORM: Ba nēk va-mrōs nēk s-kal wor a Mke-Grāt, nēk s-tek o tuar wasn̄in, o tuar bē sa kma t-var ti (k)ak o Bē Dōnōm.
S.TRANSL: But if you want, you can still climb the volcano and go see a different place – a river, which we call River Donom.

S.FORM: Nēk s-van, Wedām so van ma nēk aē.
S.TRANSL: If you go there, Wendaam will come with you.

S.FORM: Van ma nēk, s-kal ma nēk sag nēk s-tek o bē.
S.TRANSL: He’ll come with you, take you all the way up so you can see the river.

S.FORM: Bas, nēk so qra sēw kēl ma.
S.TRANSL: And then you can climb back down.

S.FORM: Tuar bē a mken nen̄, kma t-var ti ron̄ o Bē Dōnōm.
S.TRANSL: So that river on top of the volcano, we call it River Donom.

S.FORM: Bē Dōnōm sa, o dōdōm t-aē wor kak nēk m-mat le mram sa, nēk s-van sag,
S.TRANSL: And this river Donom has a significance of its own. If one day you die in this world of ours, then you will go up there.

S.FORM: nēk s-van ror nēk s-sim o bē nen̄, nēk s-sim vagvagē,
S.TRANSL: You’ll go up to the top, and then go down to drink the river’s water. That will be the last thing you drink.

S.FORM: sur na llon̄ s-sil vtē ra tutuan̄ le mram.
S.TRANSL: Drinking it will make you forget all your loved ones in this world, for ever.
